verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the official overview saying conversations, settings, and subscription stay in sync "across every platform." That implies Grok ships multiple first-party clients, but it never names iOS or Android apps or describes their features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official iOS and Android apps, evidence of mobile feature parity (voice, Imagine, connectors, workspaces), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
